title: Hoshino Ichika — An Awaited Message〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That student council business took up more time than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're supposed to have our after party with Miku and the others today too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure they're waiting on the rooftop already. I should hurry over and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you doing here, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?! Oh, Ichi, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A-Also, I should be asking you the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I heard that you're gonna be running a little late because of student council stuff, but not this late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I had a feeling that you'd all be waiting for me. I should've let you all know sooner.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, Ichi, we're not blaming you...!
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A-Anyway, let's head up to the rooftop!
We've got a fun and spectacular after party to attend♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki's acting kind of strange...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, what if...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But remember what Saku said?
“A band's number one goal is to have your music heard by as many people as possible.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something that feels a lot more important comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think getting to play music with all of you matters more to me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I'm kinda worried about how I feel right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I started doubting my commitment when it comes to going pro, and it scared me a little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Are those thoughts still lingering in her mind...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, she has to find the answer to those questions herself...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something I wanted to tell you after the show, but I didn't get a chance because of how crazy things were.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what do you wanna tell me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: From start to finish, you put on a really amazing performance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really let your feelings of excitement flow while you played...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you ended up enjoying our solo show the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way you played made me want to do the same thing with my guitar and while I sang. And it felt so good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Saki, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, stop! You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was able to have as much fun as I did because we were all playing together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, the crowd played a huge role by waving their hands for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they really got into it and responded so well to all our shout-outs. Actually, it was probably the best response we've ever received.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Definitely♪ I don't think we've ever been more one with the crowd!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we get to do another show like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've done it once now, so I'm sure we'll be able to do it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Next time, we might get to play at a venue with an even bigger capacity.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! That'd be so awesome!
It'd be like playing in front of a sea of people! Right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness she's feeling better...)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Ichika? Saki? Where are you two?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Their voices came from this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
I thought so too...
But the others are already up on the rooftop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! I totally forgot! The others are waiting for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We need to hurry!
Let's go, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
